extDescription.message: Capture the rendered page and import it into OpenPencil as editable design nodes.

pickHint.message: Click an element to capture it

endpointHint.message: Desktop app: Settings → MCP → start the server (default port 3100).

statusSentLocalFallback.message: Your account session had expired, so this went to the OpenPencil on this computer: $1 nodes imported.

statusTruncated.message: Note: the page hit the extractor's 40,000-node cap, so the capture is partial.

errorRestrictedTab.message: Chrome does not allow extensions to run on this page. Open a normal http(s) page and try again.

errorInjection.message: Could not run the capture script in this tab: $1

errorNoSnapshot.message: The extractor produced no snapshot (the page may have no visible body).

errorChunkLost.message: The captured snapshot was lost mid-transfer (the page probably navigated). Try again.

errorEndpoint.message: Endpoint must be loopback with a port — 127.0.0.1:3100, localhost:3100, or [::1]:3100.

errorOffline.message: OpenPencil is not reachable at $1. Launch the desktop app and start Settings → MCP → server, or run: openpencil-desktop --serve-web 3100

errorTimeout.message: OpenPencil at $1 accepted the connection but did not answer within $2s. It may be busy or stuck — check the app, then try again.

errorNoIngress.message: This OpenPencil build has no extension ingress ($1). Update the app, or use Download .op and open the file in OpenPencil.

errorTooLarge.message: This capture is larger than $1 MB, which OpenPencil's snapshot route refuses. Use Download .op, then open the file in OpenPencil.

errorAccountTooLarge.message: This capture is larger than $1 MB, which the account inbox refuses. Deliver it to this device instead.

errorCoreMissing.message: This extension has not been built. Run packages/op-chrome-extension/scripts/build-wasm.sh, then hit Reload on the extension card. ($1)

errorCoreInit.message: The extension is built, but its logic core would not start. Re-run packages/op-chrome-extension/scripts/build-wasm.sh and hit Reload on the extension card. ($1)

errorPickUnavailable.message: Element capture is unavailable: the extension's background worker is not running. Check the extension card in chrome://extensions for an error, re-run build-wasm.sh, then hit Reload. ($1)

accountSignInOpened.message: Finish signing in on the page that just opened, then reopen this popup.

accountSignedOut.message: Signed out of your OpenPencil account.

accountSignOutManual.message: Finish signing out on the account page that just opened.

accountUnavailable.message: Your OpenPencil account could not be reached: $1

errorAccountSignedOut.message: Your OpenPencil account session has expired. Sign in again, then try once more.

errorAccountForbidden.message: The hub refused this upload's origin or session token. Sign in again, then try once more. ($1)

errorAccountQuota.message: Your account inbox is full — it holds at most $1 snapshots or $2 MB. Delete some on the account page, then try again. ($3)

errorAccountRateLimited.message: Too many uploads to your account. Try again a little later. ($1)

errorAccountRateLimitedMinutes.message: Too many uploads to your account. Try again in about $1 minutes.

errorAccountRateLimitedSeconds.message: Too many uploads to your account. Try again in about $1 seconds.

errorAccountRejected.message: Your OpenPencil account refused the snapshot: $1

errorAccountUnavailable.message: Your OpenPencil account cannot accept captures right now ($1). Try again later, or send to the OpenPencil on this computer.
